title: The Rev. John Philip Anderson Morshead
dates: (<i>c</i>.1809-7 Sept 1881)
---

cousin of CMY

He matriculated from Exeter Coll 1827 and from 1854 was Vicar of Salcombe Regis.

His grandmother was Elizabeth Yonge, sister of the Rev.

Duke Yonge, Vicar of Cornwood, so he and his brother Captain Pentyre Anderson Morshead were cousins of the Yonges of Puslinch and of CMY.

He married (1845) his second cousin Alethea Yonge (1815-1863), eldest daughter of the Rev.

John Yonge of Puslinch.
